original_test_intent: Verify every NVSM-reported system component version and health/status field matches the approved platform firmware/software manifest.
original_method: Pin approved NVSM package; preserve logs; inventory managed component identities and schema; run exact `nvsm show versions` read-only; retain raw hierarchy/version/status/health fields; compare every required component/attribute to the version manifest, including active/staged semantics where exposed; flag missing/extra/unknown entries without updating firmware.
manual_activity: Firmware/platform owner provides the expected component/version manifest and owns disposition of missing, extra or mismatched properties.
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, install packages or flash components
Do not coerce version formats or aliases without policy
agent_execution_scope: Compare every scoped property and retain raw output

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command is applicable for inventory, but correctness requires an identity-aware component manifest and version semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command from the approved NVSM build and compare all returned properties to the governed manifest.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All system version properties remain in scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build an identity-keyed expected-versus-observed table retaining raw version, active/staged status and health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines correct per component without any update action.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A subset of headline firmware versions cannot prove every NVSM property.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Component naming and bank semantics can change across NVSM/platform releases.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner defines accepted version aliases, active versus staged expectations and optional components.
expected_evidence: Approved component/version manifest and schema map

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently target version-property correctness; the absent reference manifest is a project input, while log clearing is rejected for safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and expected manifest are provisionable; collection is read-only.

review_improvement: Makes version correctness component-complete and bank-aware without turning inventory into firmware remediation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same version string can refer to staged or active firmware and identical component names can repeat across devices. Stable component identity and bank/status fields are necessary to avoid accepting a correct string on the wrong target or inactive bank.
